title: fix(fields): a lookup pick after a search reaches the field, and the trigger shows the picked record (objectui#13162)
body:
Fixes #13162

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong, as measured

Both halves were measured in Chromium (1440×900) against HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52`, booted locally with its npm `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5. That release's prebuilt console bundles objectui `4016370`, whose `LookupField.tsx`, `useRecordQuery.ts` and popover wrapper are byte-identical to `main`. Two hosts were driven: the Delegations create form (an object form in a dialog) and the Set Manager action dialog. The server answers the searched and the unsearched `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user` with the same row shape, `id` included, so the answer is not the cause.

**(a) After typing `mar` (one match), on the Delegator lookup:**

| how the pick was made | published console (before) | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| click on the row once the answer landed | set | set |
| click at once, before the debounce fired | set | set |
| Enter, no arrow key | **nothing set**, popover stays open | set |
| ArrowDown before the answer landed, Enter after | **nothing set** | set |
| ArrowDown then Enter, after the answer | set | set |
| mouse click at coordinates read before the answer landed | **nothing set**, popover dismissed | nothing set (see Acceptance notes) |

The Set Manager dialog gives the same readings, so the cause is the field, not `ActionParamDialog.tsx` (objectui#13161 holds that file; it is untouched here).

**(b)** A full-size single-select lookup drew its value as a chip above a trigger that kept reading "Select…". This held after a pick with or without a search, and for a value the record already held. The chip did carry the name; the trigger never did.

## What changed

- **Enter after a search (half a).** Once the rows on screen answer the typed term, the first row is the active row (named by `aria-activedescendant`), and Enter takes it. A keystroke clears the active row. While the answer is still pending (debounced or in flight), no row is made active, so Enter can never take a row from the previous term's list. With no term typed, nothing changes.
- **The signal behind it.** `useRecordQuery` (internal to `@object-ui/fields`, not on the package entry) reports `answeredSearch`, the term its `records` answer. It is set in the same commit as `records`, and a superseded answer commits nothing (objectui#10712), so it cannot set it either. The field compares it with the typed term. A guess inside the field from loading transitions was rejected: it has a window, a keystroke processed between the debounce firing and React's render, in which an old term's rows read as answering the new one.
- **The trigger shows the record (half b).** A single-select field draws the record's label in the trigger in every size, as compact mode already did, with the whole label on hover when it is cut short. A search-first (people) field also draws the avatar there, through the same read gate the chip used. The single-select chip goes, so the name is drawn once; its ✕ moves beside the trigger with the same accessible name ("Remove LABEL") and the same disabled rule. Multi-select keeps its chips and its "N selected" trigger. The placeholder reads muted in both sizes. The picked row already carries the label, so nothing is read again to draw it.

**File surface, declared.** The claim named `LookupField.tsx`. The exact "rows answer the term" signal belongs to the query kernel beside it, `useRecordQuery.ts`, so this PR also touches that file: one additive member on an internal hook result. No open PR touches either file (all 9 open PRs read, 123 files). No export, prop or accept set moves: the built `dist/index.d.ts` has 0 hits for `UseRecordQueryResult` and `answeredSearch` (control: `LookupField`, 3 hits). The hook's own declaration file ships under `dist/widgets/` as every widget's does, and is reachable from no `exports` key.

## Evidence

- **Pin:** `LookupField.pickSticks-13162.test.tsx`, 13 tests, driving the real `LookupField` through a controlled host.
- **Ablation 1, both halves.** The fix's two source files were set back to their `d05f33b` bytes (both hashes checked against the base blobs), then the pin was run: 7 failed, 6 passed. The 7 are the behaviour tests: three for (a) and four for (b). For (b), "Priya Raman" was expected and "Select…" received. The 6 are the controls and the pending-Enter guard. Restored with `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty, both hashes equal to HEAD's: 13/13.
- **Ablation 2, the guard.** The "rows answer the term" condition was dropped from the default row (anchor hit once, blob changed, restored blob equal to HEAD). Only the pending-Enter guard went red: an active row appeared while the answer was still held.
- **Live, after, on this branch's console** (dev server proxied to the same backend). Set Manager: type `mar`, and "Marta Quinn" is the active row. Enter puts it in the trigger, and Confirm sends `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager` with `managerId`, which answers 200 and closes the dialog. Business Units, New, parent: one click with no search, and the trigger reads "QA EMEA Sales". The Delegations table above, right-hand column.
- **Local gates at `0498442`** (exit codes captured before any pipe):
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields lint`: 0, with 0 errors. The touched source files carry no new warnings: `LookupField.tsx` went from 53 to 52, `useRecordQuery.ts` stayed at 6. The pin has none.
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check`: 0.
  - Vitest over 111 files that render or test the lookup pickers, across fields, app-shell, plugin-form, plugin-grid, plugin-detail, components and types: 1543 passed.
  - `check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new citations), `check:control-bytes` 0, `check:changeset-claims` 0, `check-changeset-presence` 0, `check-changeset-no-major` 0.
  - i18n gates are not owed: no string or key changes, and the clear control reuses `lookup.remove`.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/13162-lookup-pick-sticks.md`, `@object-ui/fields` patch.

## Acceptance notes

- **A click aimed at the rows shown before the answer lands can still reach no row.** Typing narrows the list only when the debounced answer lands. A click aimed at "Marta Quinn" in the three-row list, but pressed after the list shrank to one row, lands below the shrunken popover, which then dismisses. Nothing is set, and nothing could be: the press never reached a row. Measured on both consoles. A click that reaches a row always commits it, before and after this change. The open question in the dev report covers whether anything should change here. The candidate, narrowing the loaded rows on each keystroke, would add a second, client-side search beside the server-resolved one (ADR-0061), so it is not done here.
- **The card's "text click" failure did not reproduce.** A Playwright locator click on the row committed, both once the answer had landed and at once after typing. A locator click measures the row, then presses its centre, so a list that shrinks between the two is the pointer race above. That is the likely reading, not a measured one.
- **Observation, not filed:** a single-select value whose record no longer resolves (deleted, unreadable) draws the placeholder once hydration settles. This is unchanged by this PR, and was not measured in a browser.
- **The live harness.** HotCRM at `f22dfa52`, booted `--fresh`. Two throwaway users and one business unit were created through the admin API. Everything ran on private ports and was stopped by PID after the readings. The Delegations create request answered 403 for a delegator other than self: that is the card's sibling finding F-14, not this one.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)

Implemented by a dispatched `os-dev` run; PM session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014MXhk1yjWh37d634hLy3p7`.
